meaning: Exact path inventory and replacement ownership; component source findings and observed results are in static-module-alignment.md. File presence or an old test pass is not current-spec implementation acceptance. Shared APIs may be consumed by later tasks; the listed owner leads adaptation, not a blanket rewrite or deletion of every file.

boundaries.disposition: Remove the API whose only callers are the abandoned interface-preview leaf; preserve live operand preparation through expression evaluation.
Adapt lexical/typed connections; remove mixed-interface previews; retain source-owned holes and exact congruence with new consumers.
Retain exact name/layout primitives; replace mixed static interfaces, explicit formal signatures and static positions/skips with current syntax; remove obsolete parser-only cases.
Adapt whole-graph public binders/free inputs; ordinary interfaces introduce Type only; remove explicit-formal and forward-only-alias branches.
Replace explicit/exhaustive expected signatures with minimum use requirements; retain complete actual constructor metadata and all residual formals.
Retain nonexpanding immutable terms/occurs/congruence laws; replace positional static normalization and exhaustive-signature recovery with current named applications.
Retain exact graph algorithms and independent finite oracles; adapt ordinary/static owner provenance and new binder roles before all expansion/cache paths.
Adapt definition/equality witnesses and complete producer closure to separate static graphs; remove ordinary interface projection/preview paths and their sole-purpose tests.
Adapt independent concrete named-export selectors and namespace closure; retain declared-Type evidence without literal/member-name inference.
Adapt new AST path positions and static module kinds; retain exact roots/request spans and source-cycle loading.
Retain full qualified identity encoding/collision checks; add a dedicated closed-candidate registry with explicit pending checks and guarded cache dependencies, currently absent.
Adapt current concrete pipeline to guarded closure; no specialization execution support currently established.
Separate lexical source order from globally refinable Types, using current simple interfaces and ready export evidence.
Adapt one-source-one-Type assumptions to validated specializations; retain ordinary operation/ownership/capability checks.
Adapt startup identity to specialization/member keys; retain ordered construction and reverse successful-prefix cleanup.
Adapt closed identity/layout/control handoff; retain stable slot and resolved storage contracts.
Adapt source-only code/constant keys to full specialization identities; retain label dispatch and native entry inlining.
Retain precise source-byte spans and cleanup lifetime; add producer/application/definition chains without fictitious runtime frames.
Retain concrete native ABI/toolchain; adapt selected closed-Type consumer metadata without generic native definitions.
Retain configured-root and input invalidation model; adapt separate static graph and template dependencies.
Adapt common frontend indexing/navigation/rename to exact static binder and actual-signature labels; retain checked transactions.
Adapt resolved reference spans only; retain transactional relocation/recovery and distinguish producer paths from returned Type identity.
Retain checked C facade and owned-child boundary; add current static export exclusion and independent-peer cleanup acceptance.
Retain reviewed per-file mapping mechanism; update only after corresponding replacement and actual test review, never to conceal stale behavior.
Retain common test harness/source lists; each changing consumer updates this shared input with its own evidence.
